datasets.name: comparability_modes
queryLines: SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('Standardized (comparable across eras)'), ('Raw (as collected)')) AS t(mode)

datasets.name: coverage_monthly
queryLines:
SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', event_hour) AS month, source,
                   COUNT(*) AS hours_observed
            FROM github_observatory.gold.ecosystem_hourly
            WHERE (IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Raw (as collected)' OR NOT in_outage)
            GROUP BY 1, 2

datasets.name: regime_monthly
queryLines:
SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', event_hour) AS month,
                   ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Standardized (comparable across eras)' THEN (CASE WHEN CAST(event_hour AS DATE) < DATE'2025-06-01' THEN push_events * 0.696 ELSE push_events END) ELSE push_events END)
                         / SUM(CASE WHEN IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Standardized (comparable across eras)' THEN (CASE WHEN CAST(event_hour AS DATE) < DATE'2025-06-01' THEN total_events * 0.714 ELSE total_events END) ELSE total_events END), 4) AS push_share,
                   CASE WHEN date_trunc('MONTH', event_hour) < DATE'2025-06-01' AND IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Standardized (comparable across eras)' THEN 'to May 2025 — re-based estimate' WHEN date_trunc('MONTH', event_hour) < DATE'2025-06-01' THEN 'to May 2025 — as collected' ELSE 'Jun 2025 on — as collected (~30% fewer events published)' END AS regime
            FROM github_observatory.gold.ecosystem_hourly
            WHERE (IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Raw (as collected)' OR NOT in_outage)
            GROUP BY 1, 3

datasets.name: production_decade
queryLines:
SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', event_hour) AS month,
                   CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Standardized (comparable across eras)' THEN (CASE WHEN CAST(event_hour AS DATE) < DATE'2025-06-01' THEN push_events * 0.696 ELSE push_events END) ELSE push_events END) / COUNT(*) AS BIGINT)
                       AS pushes_per_hour,
                   CASE WHEN date_trunc('MONTH', event_hour) < DATE'2025-06-01' AND IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Standardized (comparable across eras)' THEN 'to May 2025 — re-based estimate' WHEN date_trunc('MONTH', event_hour) < DATE'2025-06-01' THEN 'to May 2025 — as collected' ELSE 'Jun 2025 on — as collected (~30% fewer events published)' END AS regime
            FROM github_observatory.gold.ecosystem_hourly
            WHERE (IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Raw (as collected)' OR NOT in_outage)
            GROUP BY 1, 3

datasets.name: production_yoy
queryLines:
WITH m AS (
                SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', event_hour) AS month,
                       SUM(CASE WHEN IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Standardized (comparable across eras)' THEN (CASE WHEN CAST(event_hour AS DATE) < DATE'2025-06-01' THEN push_events * 0.696 ELSE push_events END) ELSE push_events END) / COUNT(*) AS pushes_per_hour,
                       COUNT(*) AS hours_observed
                FROM github_observatory.gold.ecosystem_hourly
                WHERE (IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Raw (as collected)' OR NOT in_outage)
                GROUP BY 1
            )
            SELECT c.month,
                   ROUND((c.pushes_per_hour - p.pushes_per_hour)
                         / p.pushes_per_hour, 4) AS yoy_growth,
                   CASE WHEN c.month < DATE'2025-06-01'
                        THEN 'full feed (thru May 2025)'
                        ELSE 'filtered feed (Jun 2025 on, OQ-1)' END AS regime
            FROM m c
            JOIN m p ON p.month = c.month - INTERVAL 12 MONTHS
            WHERE NOT (c.month >= DATE'2025-06-01' AND p.month < DATE'2025-06-01')
              -- partial months bias the comparison (day-of-week mix):
              -- require near-full coverage on both sides
              AND c.hours_observed >= 600 AND p.hours_observed >= 600

datasets.name: production_hourly_stream
queryLines:
SELECT event_hour, production_events,
                   CASE WHEN IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Standardized (comparable across eras)' THEN (CASE WHEN CAST(event_hour AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2025-10-09' AND DATE'2025-12-01' THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE pr_merged END) ELSE pr_merged END AS pr_merged,
                   releases_published
            FROM github_observatory.gold.ecosystem_hourly
            WHERE source = 'stream' AND (IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Raw (as collected)' OR NOT in_outage)

datasets.name: flow_decade
queryLines:
WITH daily AS (
                SELECT CAST(event_hour AS DATE) AS day,
                       COUNT(*) AS hrs,
                       AVG(push_events) AS mean,
                       STDDEV_POP(push_events) AS std,
                       SUM(push_events) AS tot
                FROM github_observatory.gold.ecosystem_hourly
                WHERE (IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Raw (as collected)' OR NOT in_outage)
                GROUP BY 1
            ),
            entropy AS (
                SELECT CAST(e.event_hour AS DATE) AS day,
                       -SUM(CASE WHEN e.push_events > 0 AND d.tot > 0
                                 THEN (e.push_events / d.tot)
                                      * ln(e.push_events / d.tot)
                                 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ent
                FROM github_observatory.gold.ecosystem_hourly e
                JOIN daily d ON CAST(e.event_hour AS DATE) = d.day
                GROUP BY 1
            )
            SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', d.day) AS month,
                   ROUND(AVG(try_divide(d.std, d.mean)), 4) AS cv,
                   ROUND(AVG(try_divide(d.std - d.mean, d.std + d.mean)), 4)
                       AS burstiness,
                   ROUND(AVG(e.ent), 4) AS entropy,
                   CASE WHEN date_trunc('MONTH', d.day) < DATE'2025-06-01'
                        THEN 'full feed (thru May 2025)'
                        ELSE 'filtered feed (Jun 2025 on, OQ-1)' END AS regime
            FROM daily d JOIN entropy e USING (day)
            WHERE d.hrs = 24
            GROUP BY 1, 5

                   CASE WHEN IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Standardized (comparable across eras)' THEN (CASE WHEN CAST(event_hour AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2025-10-09' AND DATE'2025-12-01' THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE pr_merged END) ELSE pr_merged END AS pr_merged

                   COUNT(*) AS reviews
            FROM github_observatory.silver.review_events
            WHERE (IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Raw (as collected)' OR NOT ((CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2019-09-12' AND DATE'2019-09-12') OR (CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2020-08-21' AND DATE'2020-08-23') OR (CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2021-03-09' AND DATE'2021-03-10') OR (CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2021-05-08' AND DATE'2021-05-11') OR (CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2021-08-26' AND DATE'2021-08-27') OR (CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2021-10-06' AND DATE'2021-10-29') OR (CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2025-10-09' AND DATE'2025-10-14')))

datasets.name: engagement_hourly
queryLines:
SELECT date_trunc('HOUR', created_at) AS event_hour,
                   COUNT_IF(event_type = 'WatchEvent') AS stars,
                   COUNT_IF(event_type = 'ForkEvent') AS forks
            FROM github_observatory.silver.events
            WHERE quality_flag IS NULL AND created_at IS NOT NULL
              AND event_type IN ('WatchEvent', 'ForkEvent')
              AND (IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Raw (as collected)' OR NOT ((CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2019-09-12' AND DATE'2019-09-12') OR (CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2020-08-21' AND DATE'2020-08-23') OR (CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2021-03-09' AND DATE'2021-03-10') OR (CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2021-05-08' AND DATE'2021-05-11') OR (CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2021-08-26' AND DATE'2021-08-27') OR (CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2021-10-06' AND DATE'2021-10-29') OR (CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2025-10-09' AND DATE'2025-10-14')))

queryLines:
SELECT event_hour, actual, prediction
            FROM github_observatory.gold.forecast_predictions
            WHERE target = 'total_events' AND method = 'seasonal_24h'
              AND event_hour >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
              AND (IFNULL(:standardize, 'Standardized (comparable across eras)') = 'Raw (as collected)' OR NOT ((CAST(event_hour AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2019-09-12' AND DATE'2019-09-12') OR (CAST(event_hour AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2020-08-21' AND DATE'2020-08-23') OR (CAST(event_hour AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2021-03-09' AND DATE'2021-03-10') OR (CAST(event_hour AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2021-05-08' AND DATE'2021-05-11') OR (CAST(event_hour AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2021-08-26' AND DATE'2021-08-27') OR (CAST(event_hour AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2021-10-06' AND DATE'2021-10-29') OR (CAST(event_hour AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2025-10-09' AND DATE'2025-10-14')))

widget.name: regime_note
widget.textbox_spec:
## How to read this observatory

Everything here derives from GitHub's **public events feed** (via GH Archive
and its BigQuery mirror). For a decade that feed was a **census** of public
activity. Since mid-2025 it is not.

**The regime change (OQ-1).** Starting **June 2025** (volume −26% in one
month) with a second step in **October 2025**, most non-push event classes
were progressively dropped or sampled upstream — by 2026 stars run at ~44/hr
and PR events ~189/hr *for all of public GitHub*, which is implausibly low,
while pushes were cut less deeply (−28% in June 2025; push share rose
64% → 94%). The BigQuery mirror is faithful — an archive hour file and
its BigQuery rows match to the event (verified 2025-07-15T15) — so the
steps are in the feed itself, not the collection.
Archive coverage was complete throughout, ruling out collection gaps: the
*feed itself* was filtered. Who filters (GitHub's /events API vs archive
collection) and by what rule is unresolved — tracked as **OQ-1**.

**Reading rules**

* **Full feed (thru May 2025)** — levels and trends are ecosystem facts.
* **Filtered feed (Jun 2025 on)** — only **push-based** metrics are
  trustworthy in absolute terms; star/fork/PR/issue numbers are a sample of
  unknown coverage. Fine for movement *within* the regime; never compare
  levels across the color boundary.
* The bot-share "drop" at the boundary (~27% → ~9%) is the filter changing
  the *measured mix*, not bots leaving — bots disproportionately emit the
  filtered event types.

**Provenance.** Rows are tagged by `source`: `bigquery` = decade import from
the public dataset (census columns; deduped on event id); `stream` = our own
hourly ingestion (2026-07 onward, full event detail). Stream rows always win
on overlap. Jan–Jun 2026 is a known gap.

widget.name: std_production_note
widget.textbox_spec:
**Comparability control.** Defaults to *Standardized*, which applies the
constraints of the most constrained era to the whole series: collection-outage
days are dropped (they are floors, not measurements), and metrics read NULL
where the signal was structurally absent rather than 0 — a zero is
indistinguishable from "it stopped happening"; and levels before 2025-06-01 are
**re-based** onto today's measurement footing, which closes the artificial step
where the feed began publishing ~30% fewer events. Re-based values are
estimates, not measurements. Switch to *Raw* to see the record as collected,
step and all.

Re-basing covers the 2025-06-01 step only, where the cut was measured and
uniform. It is **not** applied after 2025-10-08: the feed flaps week to week
through 2026 and offers no stable basis to index against, so lifecycle series
there are unavailable rather than adjusted. See `docs/normalization_basis.md`.
